trigger: Creator supplied revised copy and asked to create the carousel with the best possible visual production and cinematography.

selection_reason: It is physically causal, mutually authored, cinematographically progressive and readable with copy hidden.
production_design: One compact rental room with a narrow aisle, low divan, small work table, one chair, one wardrobe door, one lamp, one extension board, two work bags, damp umbrella and one untouched simple meal. No generic cozy filler.
lighting_arc: Cool rainy-window ambience plus warm practical lamp -> taut-cord instability -> cool blackout -> jointly restored warm pool.
rejected_visual_patterns: generic hug, kiss or apology bouquet payoff
